story.title: Story 2: Chunk Assembly From Turn Projections

result.reviewScopeSummary: Read the Story 2 spec, full tech design, and test plan; inspected chunk/projection/runtime-selection code and supporting tests; audited production paths for placeholder-era behavior; and ran the configured story and epic gates.

newFindings.title: Lower-band runtime still derives detailed/brief output from smooth-text placeholders instead of the persisted conversation transcript
newFindings.evidence: Story 2 requires detailed and brief to share the conversation-only chunk transcript as source and to keep lower-band sourcing separate from smooth text (`docs/spec-build/epics/05-real-lower-band-compression/stories/02-chunk-assembly-from-turn-projections.md:70-90`; `docs/spec-build/epics/05-real-lower-band-compression/tech-design.md:168-175,658-660`). The production path still runs through placeholder generation based on `chunk.smoothText`: `validateChunkForPlaceholderBuild` and `buildPlaceholderRecord` require/build from smooth text (`src/thread/async-thread/services/placeholder-artifact-service.ts:112-181`), maintenance still calls `ensurePlaceholderArtifacts` for closed legacy chunks (`src/thread/async-thread/services/async-thread-run-service.ts:1143-1163`), and lower-band accounting still accepts placeholder artifacts (`src/thread-view/services/thread-view-builder.ts:309-343`). Passing runtime tests still bless placeholder output as success-path behavior in PI output and smart compact (`tests/thread-view/pi-thread-view-builder.test.ts:10-55`; `tests/commands/smart-compact-lifecycle.integration.test.ts:559-604`).

newFindings.title: Legacy placeholder chunks are only blocked after cutover starts, so all-legacy threads still select old lower-band state
newFindings.evidence: Story 2 says placeholder-era chunks are not selectable after this epic and must remain explicitly distinguishable from the new path (`docs/spec-build/epics/05-real-lower-band-compression/stories/02-chunk-assembly-from-turn-projections.md:92-105`; `docs/spec-build/epics/05-real-lower-band-compression/tech-design.md:427-429,662-666`). In code, blocking is conditional: `hasConversationOnlyChunkCutover()` only turns on when some chunk already has `schemaVersion === "conversation_only_chunk_v1"` (`src/thread/async-thread/domain/chunk-state.ts:109-110`), and both runtime selection paths only reject legacy chunks behind that flag (`src/thread-view/services/thread-view-builder.ts:448-492`; `src/thread/async-thread/services/async-thread-run-service.ts:251-288`). The test suite still preserves the all-legacy success path: `closed chunk can enter lower band` selects the legacy closed chunks (`tests/thread-view/thread-view-builder.test.ts:460-480`), while the blocker tests only pass after manually injecting a new-schema chunk (`tests/thread-view/thread-view-builder.test.ts:548-596`; `tests/thread/async-thread-run-service.test.ts:609-657`).

productionPathFindings: Real runtime still emits and consumes placeholder lower-band artifacts on legacy-only threads.
The only lower-band artifact generation path inspected here still derives from `chunk.smoothText`, not `chunk.conversationTranscript`.
additionalObservations: Both configured gates passed, but the passing suite still contains explicit placeholder-era success-path assertions, so gate success is not sufficient evidence of Story 2 readiness.

The published Story 2 test mapping points TC-2.4/TC-2.5/TC-2.6 proof to `tests/thread/chunk-service.test.ts`, but the current file only demonstrates boundary counts, transcript assembly, smooth-text preservation, and `sourceTurnIds` stability.
